prompts.rat: Create a production game sprite animation sheet, transparent background, no text or labels. Wide 5-column by 1-row sheet, exactly five evenly spaced equal cells. Each cell contains the SAME grotesque mutated rat facing RIGHT in side view, entire tail and feet visible, no overlap. Frame 1 idle; frame 2 walk left forepaw forward/right rear paw forward; frame 3 passing paws beneath body; frame 4 opposite contact with right forepaw forward/left rear forward; frame 5 opposite passing with raised paw. Distinct readable walking silhouettes. Swallowed city rat slowly mutated by radiation: indigo-purple fur, hunched swollen pink tumor sacs along spine, lime green luminous eye and tiny drool, torn ear, long curved bare pink tail, two ears, four legs only. Cartoon pixel art consistent with the chef in the reference: crisp tiny stair-step edges, dark near-black outline, rich magenta purple shadows, warm cream edge highlights, fine native 1px details, NOT smooth painted art, NOT coarse enlarged pixels. Rat body at ~half chef height and including tail ~chef width. References style only; draw new pixels. Large transparent gaps around every frame, align ground at same height.
prompts.human: Production sprite animation sheet for the same cartoon pixel-art game as the attached chef STYLE reference. Transparent background, NO text, labels or grid lines. Crisp black contour, visibly stepped pixel edges, small dither clusters, pink rim lighting, purple shadows, tiny fine pixel highlights. Cartoon and expressive like chef, not realistic gore or smooth rendering. Whole figure inside every cell.
